### Savor the Salt
Author: Luann Prater
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/savor-the-salt-encouragement-cafe-december-25-2019.html
Passage: Leviticus 2:13
Points:
- Salt is an essential substance created by God, used both for seasoning food and for cleansing.
- Bethlehem shepherds treated newborn sacrificial lambs with salt water to disinfect them, pointing to Christ's birth and role as the flawless sacrifice.
- In biblical tradition, a covenant of salt represents an unbreakable guarantee of divine loyalty and friendship.
- God's enduring promises extend to believers today through His covenant bond.
- Reflecting on God's covenant faithfulness encourages Christians to live seasoned lives that honor and magnify Him.
